drg.description: Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without MV >96 Hours with MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 77-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.44, creatinine 1.07, hemoglobin 12.6, platelets 220, sodium 141, wbc 6.3; vitals dbp 78-83, heart_rate 84-87, map 96-99, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 128-134, spo2 96-97, temp 37.1-37.5
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Sepsis.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.05, hemoglobin 12.5, platelets 221, sodium 140, wbc 6.5; vitals dbp 77-82, heart_rate 83-88, map 96-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 128-134, spo2 95-97, temp 36.9-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Sepsis. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 77-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Sepsis. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
